title: Implement Proposition TE / One-time exemption from the City special documentary transfer tax established under Measure ULA for qualifying properties impacted by the January 2025 wildfires
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council instruct the Office of Finance, and request the City Attorney, to take the necessary administrative actions to implement Proposition TE upon of the election results confirming its passage, and report back to the City Council certification with recommendations for any additional Council actions necessary to ensure its effective implementation.
